DIAGNOSIS READY: Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis (TEN) secondary to captopril.

The patient's presentation of widespread blistering, painful mucosal ulcers (oral and genital), and recent initiation of captopril is classic for severe cutaneous adverse reactions (SCARs), specifically TEN or Stevens-Johnson Syndrome. The presence of a family history of autoimmune conditions does not rule out this life-threatening drug reaction. Immediate cessation of the offending agent is required, and the patient needs urgent admission for supportive care and wound management.
